sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
We repeat words and ideas many times.
Annecy is close to nature and water.
France is a country in Europe.
It is famous all over the world.
Annecy is in the east of France.
It is close to the border with Switzerland.
The city is near the Alps Mountains.
Annecy is next to a lake.
The lake is called Lake Annecy.
The city feels fresh and clean.
The city looks soft and quiet.
In winter, it can be cold.
People lived here many years ago.
The city was important in the past.
It was a place of trade and travel.
History is part of daily life in Annecy.
Annecy has a beautiful old town.
Small canals run through the streets.
The old town feels warm and romantic.
Annecy is sometimes called the Venice of the Alps.
Water is part of daily life.
The water is clean and blue.
The lake gives life to the city.
Daily life in Annecy is slow and calm.
Food in Annecy is simple and warm.
People eat cheese, bread and soup.
Nature is very close to Annecy.
Nature is part of everyday life.
Annecy is a city of water, mountains, history and calm life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
